definitions.low: drawdown_60 <= -15%; adjusted close <=5% above causal 60-session adjusted intraday low; >=120 valid sessions; 20-session median amount >= CNY10m; hard-valid trading non-ST row with clean 60-session lineage
definitions.crash_speed: -causal adjusted Ret10 / -drawdown_60; larger means more of the current 60-session peak drawdown was accumulated recently
definitions.market_relative_20: causal stock Ret20 minus compounded 20-session return of the equal-weight eligible market; larger means less stock-specific underperformance / more systematic decline
definitions.industry_relative_20: causal stock Ret20 minus compounded 20-session return of its PIT-industry equal-weight eligible universe
definitions.near_low_score: -distance_from_low_60; larger means closer to the causal 60-session low
definitions.outcomes: gross adjusted returns from next legal session open through adjusted close at 5/10/20 sessions; full hard-valid 20-session path required
definitions.deduplication: first LOW observation after no LOW in the previous 20 trading rows
definitions.axis_terciles: pooled Slow/Medium/Fast or Idiosyncratic/Mixed/Systematic terciles formed separately within each primary depth bucket
